question: what was the largest invoice this month and from who
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, b.invoice_number, SUM((bi.price * bi.quantity - COALESCE(bi.discount, 0)) * (1 + COALESCE(bi.tax, 0) / 100)) AS total FROM bills b JOIN bill_items bi ON bi.bill_id = b.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = b.customer_id WHERE b.type = 'Invoice' AND b.created_at >= '2026-06-01' AND b.created_at < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY c.name, b.invoice_number ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1
agent_sql_scrubbed: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id = 80;
